title: Diplomatic incident: {rival} protests
body: An intelligence operation on foreign soil has been exposed. {rival} has summoned the ambassador and the press is demanding answers.

choices.label: Express regret
choices.description: Relations recover somewhat; the opposition calls it weak.
choices.outcome: A carefully worded statement of regret calms the capitals. Critics at home complain.

choices.label: Expel their diplomats in return
choices.description: Plays well at home; relations sour further and tension rises.
choices.outcome: Both countries expel diplomats. The public likes the firmness; the border grows tenser.

choices.label: Deny everything
choices.description: No cost, but relations stay poor.
choices.outcome: The government denies all knowledge. Nobody believes it, but the story fades.

title: Officers and jawans press for a pay rise
body: Service associations say the cost of living has outrun military pay. Retired officers have joined the campaign.

choices.label: Approve a pay rise
choices.description: Costs ₹3,000 cr; morale and army loyalty improve.
choices.outcome: A generous pay award lifts spirits across the services.

choices.label: Set up a pay commission
choices.description: Costs ₹300 cr; a small, slow improvement.
choices.outcome: A commission is appointed. The services wait, cautiously.

choices.label: Say the budget is tight
choices.description: No cost; morale and loyalty fall.
choices.outcome: The services feel overlooked. Grumbling spreads in the messes.

title: Questions over a defence contract
body: A newspaper alleges inflated prices and favoured suppliers in a recent equipment contract. The opposition wants an inquiry.

choices.label: Order an independent audit
choices.description: Costs ₹400 cr; cleaner procurement, a short embarrassment.
choices.outcome: Auditors recover some money and tighten the rules. The story fades with credit to you.

choices.label: Defend the ministry
choices.description: No cost; scandal lingers.
choices.outcome: The ministry insists the contract was sound. The press keeps digging.

title: A supplier offers equipment at a discount
body: A friendly industrial power offers a batch of modern equipment on favourable terms, if you act this quarter.

choices.label: Buy the batch
choices.description: Costs ₹5,000 cr; readiness and morale improve.
choices.outcome: The equipment arrives within weeks and units re-equip quickly.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The offer lapses. Domestic manufacturers are pleased.

title: Hostile hackers probe defence networks
body: Cyber teams detect an intrusion into logistics systems. The origin is hidden behind several countries.

choices.label: Harden the networks
choices.description: Costs ₹800 cr; contained, and the lessons stick.
choices.outcome: The intrusion is sealed off and systems are upgraded.

choices.label: Contain it quietly
choices.description: No cost; readiness slips for a while.
choices.outcome: Some data is lost and units spend weeks re-checking their records.

title: Patrol crosses the northern line
body: A Zarnaki patrol has crossed the mountain frontier and camped on a ridge India patrols. Both sides are on alert.

choices.label: Protest through diplomats
choices.description: Costs ₹100 cr; the patrol withdraws.
choices.outcome: After a formal protest the patrol withdraws and tension eases.

choices.label: Surge troops to the ridge
choices.description: Costs ₹1,500 cr; shows resolve but wears on readiness.
choices.outcome: India matches the move with a show of force. The standoff ends in a stalemate and a crowded ridge.

choices.label: Watch and wait
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: Commanders watch the ridge for weeks. Nothing happens, and nobody is comfortable.

title: Aircraft stray into Indian airspace
body: Tirhani aircraft crossed the western frontier for several minutes before turning back. Fighters were scrambled.

choices.label: Lodge a protest
choices.description: No cost; relations dip slightly.
choices.outcome: Tirhan calls it a navigation error. The note is filed.

choices.label: Fly a show of force
choices.description: Costs ₹600 cr; morale up, relations down.
choices.outcome: A large formation flies along the border. Pilots are delighted; the neighbours less so.

title: Fishing boats detained in the south
body: Oruvani patrol boats have detained a group of Indian fishing crews in disputed waters. Families are appealing to the government.

choices.label: Negotiate their release
choices.description: Costs ₹150 cr; the crews come home.
choices.outcome: Quiet talks bring the crews home within the month.

choices.label: Send naval escorts
choices.description: Costs ₹700 cr; firmness at some risk.
choices.outcome: Naval escorts shadow the fleet. The crews are released, and the coast guard is proud.

choices.label: Leave it to the courts
choices.description: No cost; the families are angry.
choices.outcome: The case drags on and the families blame the government.

title: Demonstrations against the war
body: Casualty lists and rising prices have brought crowds to the streets in several cities. Some demand an end to the fighting.

choices.label: Address the nation
choices.description: No cost; steadies opinion for a while.
choices.outcome: Your broadcast steadies the country, though not everyone is convinced.

choices.label: Restrict demonstrations
choices.description: Calms the streets; voters resent it.
choices.outcome: Marches are restricted. The streets quieten and the editorials turn sharp.

choices.label: Stay the course
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The marches continue and the opposition makes the most of them.

title: The finance ministry proposes war bonds
body: With the treasury paying for the war, officials propose a patriotic bond issue to share the burden.

choices.label: Issue war bonds
choices.description: Raises ₹20,000 cr now; a small drag on growth.
choices.outcome: The bonds sell out within days.

choices.label: Not now
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The treasury carries the cost for now.

title: Foreign envoys press on the nuclear program
body: Several governments have noticed unusual activity at research sites and ask for assurances. Trade talks have slowed.

choices.label: Reject outside interference
choices.description: Popular at home; costs growth for a while.
choices.outcome: You call the demands an insult to sovereignty. Voters cheer; some partners cool.

choices.label: Offer vague assurances
choices.description: Eases the pressure; some voters see weakness.
choices.outcome: Your assurances buy time with trading partners, and cost a little at home.

title: A friendly country wants to buy Indian equipment
body: A buyer from abroad has requested a batch of surplus equipment. The deal would bring in cash.

choices.label: Approve the sale
choices.description: Brings in ₹4,000 cr.
choices.outcome: The sale goes through and the exchequer gains.

choices.label: Keep it for the forces
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: You decline. The forces appreciate it.

title: A chance to ease tensions
body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

choices.label: Open talks
choices.description: Costs ₹300 cr; relations and tension improve.
choices.outcome: Two rounds of talks end with a joint statement and fewer patrols along the frontier.

choices.label: Hold back
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

title: Proposal for a grand military parade
body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

choices.label: Hold the parade
choices.description: Costs ₹600 cr; morale and approval up, readiness dips.
choices.outcome: The parade fills the avenue. Crowds cheer and the troops stand taller.

choices.label: Keep the forces training
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

title: Units report a shortfall of trained recruits
body: Commanders say several units are below strength and training slots are unfilled.

choices.label: Launch a recruitment drive
choices.description: Costs ₹2,000 cr; readiness recovers.
choices.outcome: Recruitment centres fill and training schools run a double shift.

choices.label: Make do
choices.description: No cost; readiness slips.
choices.outcome: Commanders stretch what they have. Readiness slips again.

title: Veterans march for better care
body: Thousands of veterans have gathered in the capital to demand better pensions and medical care.

choices.label: Meet the delegation and announce a package
choices.description: Costs ₹1,200 cr; veterans and serving troops both notice.
choices.outcome: Veterans leave satisfied. Serving soldiers note how they will be treated.

choices.label: Promise a review
choices.description: No cost.
choices.outcome: The review drags on and the march is repeated.
